responsibility: Implements the SSA back-propagation optimization pass that infers information common to all uses of an SSA name and pushes it back through its definition chain. In this version the propagated fact is whether a value’s sign matters; the pass computes per-name usage_info over SSA defs and PHIs, iterates to a fixed point across backedge-dependent uses, then rewrites calls, assignments, and PHIs to strip unnecessary sign-changing operations and finally removes newly-dead definitions.
